svg.text: K10 LEVER SEAT — bought garlic press, ricer and push dicer, worked by the hand
One bent stainless plate clamps the lower handles; the hand lifts and pushes the upper handle like a person would.
lever seat X 830–1210, y 130–250 behind the cooker, ≤ 60 mm high
hand push ≤ 150 N at 4 : 1 → ≈ 600 N on the food
unpeeled-garlic press · ricer / Spätzle press · push dicer 6 / 10 mm
all three are ware: into the dishwasher after prep (P2)

The hand can push 300 N close to the wall
(y ≤ 420) and 150 N at full reach. The
bought lever (≈ 4 : 1) turns 150 N into
≈ 600 N — enough to press garlic in its skin,
rice potatoes and push carrot through a grid.

g.text: 1/3 Garlic press: the hand lifts the upper handle, drops in a clove with its skin and pushes the handle end down (≤ 150 N)
2/3 Ricer / Spätzle press: same motion; boiled potato comes out through the disc into the GN 1/3
3/3 Push dicer: the plunger pushes a carrot piece through the 10 mm grid; cubes fall into the GN
